data.answer: Patent filings by Australian small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) increased by **27 per cent in 2021 compared with 2020**, and their share of patent applicants reached a decade high, reversing a downward trend in recent years.[1]

citations.quote: In 2021, SME patent filings grew 27% from 2020, and the SME share of patent applicants has reached a decadal high, reversing a downward trend in recent years.

claims.text: Australian SME patent filings increased by 27 per cent in 2021 compared with 2020, and their share of patent applicants reached a decade high, reversing a recent downward trend.
